answer: Locks are published in timber, expire in prism, and forge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 152 aliases therefore needs 30 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4343 identities would post 2902 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
